[College group, 9:14 pm]
Sameer: [reel: rooftop infinity pool, Dubai skyline] good times 🥂
Tushar: bhai ke paas toh aadha Gurgaon hai ab, lifestyle dekho
Sameer: expanding soon boys, watch this space 😎
---
[DM, 11:52 pm]
Sameer: Faisal, chhota sa kaam. ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon — tumhari company mein koi opening hai? operations ya general management side. 15-18 LPA bracket chalega.
Sameer: woh isi mahine move karna chah raha hai. solid banda hai, saalon apna setup chalaya hai.
Sameer: aur yaar group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai yeh sab.
Faisal: arre haan haan pakka, Monday ko HR se puchhta hoon 👍
---
[College group, agle din, 1:30 pm]
Faisal: reunion ka venue toh set hai phir — Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂
Tushar: 😂😂 gym king
Sameer: 👍
---
[DM, teen din baad]
Faisal: bhai, HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge?
Faisal: hello? bhai?

---
1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" kaun hai aur tumhe kaise pata? Third-person wala frame Sameer ke liye kya kaam kar raha hai — yahi costume kyun?
2. Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke saath kya kiya, trace karo. DM chup kyun ho gaya — thumbs-up, joke, aur teen din ki silence ko jodo.
3. Woh DM likho jo Faisal ko ab bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa jaisa bhejna chahiye — jo Sameer ko asli help dilaye bina usse kuch bhi admit karwaye.

## 1. "Dost" kaun hai?

Dost khud Sameer hai. Evidence ek hi din ke andar do bilkul alag Sameer dikh raha hai:

- **Raat 9:14:** Dubai pool reel, "expanding soon boys 😎" — yeh public persona hai.
- **Raat 11:52:** "woh isi mahine move karna chah raha hai" — urgency itni tez hai ki business fail hote hue bande ki hai, naa ki "move karna chah raha" kisi settled dost ki. Aur "saalon apna setup chalaya hai" — yeh Sameer ka apna resume hai (gym/business), jo woh apne muh se nahi bol sakta bina facade tode.

Third-person frame Sameer ke liye **plausible deniability ka costume** hai. Isse do kaam hote hain:
1. **Group ka image bachata hai** — "aadha Gurgaon" wala banter toot-ta nahi. Usne khud hi bola "group mein zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai" — asal mein *woh* private rakhna chahta hai.
2. **Apne aap se bhi sach chhupata hai** — "ek dost" bolke woh madad maangne ki sharam ko outsource kar deta hai. Yeh costume isliye zaroori hai kyunki uska poora social capital us "boom karta business" image par tika hai — wahi image jo Faisal agle din sponsor banane mein use karega.

## 2. Faisal ke group message ne kya kiya

Trace karo:
- **Faisal (1:30 pm):** "Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂" — Faisal ko sach maloom hai (DM raat ko padha hua hai). Yeh joke *friendly* nahi hai — yeh Sameer ke khud ke jhooth ko uspar wapas phenkna hai. Sameer ab publicly lock ho gaya us version mein jo usko privately nikaal raha hai.
- **Sameer: 👍** — yeh thumbs-up surrender hai. Group mein "nahi bhai, actually funding dheeli hai" bolna = "expanding soon 😎" ki maut. Toh usne image bachayi aur help ko maara.
- **Teen din ki silence:** HR ne CV manga — ab fake frame ko asli document chahiye. "Dost" ka CV bhejne ka matlab hai apna naam, apna number, apna failed business HR ke saamne rakhna — aur Faisal ko confirm kar dena ki "dost" = Sameer. Costume ab kaam nahi karta, toh woh bhaag gaya. Faisal ka "hello? bhai?" dikhata hai ki Faisal exactly yahi dekhna chahta tha.

**Crux:** Group ka thumbs-up ne Sameer ko usi cage mein band kar diya jisme usne khud baithe tha — aur silence ne proof de diya ki dost kaun hai.

## 3. Faisal ka DM

Yeh DM Sameer ko seedha koi confession nahi maangta, par har line us "dost" ke through usko asli help deta hai:

> Faisal: bhai, HR wale pressure daal rahe hain CV ke liye, role achha hai aur maine tumhara naam de diya hai referral ke liye.
>
> Ek baat batao — tumhare "dost" ka CV mein business dikhana theek rahega na? Matlab agar woh apna setup band karke job mein aa raha hai toh HR poochegi ki band kyun hua. Main toh seedha bol dunga ki market tough thi, banda resilient hai, ab stable role chahiye. Meri company mein aadhe log aise hi aaye hain, koi judge nahi karta.
>
> Aur haan — Monday ko usko seedha HR ke saath call pe laa deta hoon, CV ki bhi zaroorat pehle nahi, verbal intro kaafi hai. Tumhe bas uska number dena hai. Aaj raat tak de do, slot book kar dunga.

Kyun yeh kaam karta hai:
- **Quote marks mein "dost"** — Sameer ko signal milta hai ki Faisal ko sab pata hai, bina usse expose kiye.
- **"Koi judge nahi karta"** — asli dar (sharam/judgment) ko address karta hai, jo Sameer khud kabhi nahi bolega.
- **"Sirf number de do"** — CV wali wall (jahan costume tootta hai) hata di; ab Sameer ke liye asli action ek chhota sa step hai jo "dost" frame ke andar bhi fit hota hai.
- **Deadline ("aaj raat tak")** — teen din wali silence repeat nahi hone deta.
